items.question: Trong câu "Understanding the wider context of the work and how a detail connects to the outcome", từ "wide" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding the wider context of the work and how a detail connects to the outcome", what does "wide" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: wide /waɪd/ (tính từ): rộng, bao quát. "The wider context" = bối cảnh rộng hơn, bức tranh bao quát quanh một chi tiết.
items.explanationEn: wide /waɪd/ (adjective): broad, covering a large range. "The wider context" means the bigger setting around a single detail.

items.question: Trong câu "Understanding the wider context of the work and how a detail connects to the outcome", từ "outcome" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding the wider context of the work and how a detail connects to the outcome", what does "outcome" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a way out of a place
items.explanation: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (danh từ): kết quả, thành quả. "Business outcome" = kết quả kinh doanh; outcome nhấn vào hiệu quả thực, khác với output (sản phẩm đầu ra).
items.explanationEn: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (noun): the result of an action. "Business outcome" is a common phrase; outcome stresses the real effect, unlike output (what is produced).

items.question: Trong câu "Building and using an understanding of the customer's perspective", từ "perspective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Building and using an understanding of the customer's perspective", what does "perspective" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: perspective /pərˈspek.tɪv/ (danh từ): góc nhìn, quan điểm. "From the customer's perspective" = từ góc nhìn của khách hàng; nghĩa khác là phối cảnh trong hội họa.
items.explanationEn: perspective /pərˈspek.tɪv/ (noun): a point of view. "From the customer's perspective" means from their point of view; in art it means depth in a drawing.

items.question: Trong câu "Continuously deciding what is worth doing next", từ "continuously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Continuously deciding what is worth doing next", what does "continuously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: continuously /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs.li/ (trạng từ): liên tục, không ngừng. "Continuously improve" = cải tiến liên tục; tính từ là continuous.
items.explanationEn: continuously /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs.li/ (adverb): without any break. "Continuously improve" is a common collocation; the adjective is continuous.

items.question: Trong câu "Continuously deciding what is worth doing next", từ "worth" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Continuously deciding what is worth doing next", what does "worth" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worth /wɜːrθ/ (tính từ): đáng (làm gì). "Be worth doing something" = đáng làm gì; ví dụ "worth the effort" = đáng công sức.
items.explanationEn: worth /wɜːrθ/ (adjective): deserving to be done. "Be worth doing something" means it deserves doing, as in "worth the effort".

items.question: Trong câu "Making the need concrete through real user examples", từ "concrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Making the need concrete through real user examples", what does "concrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concrete /ˈkɒŋ.kriːt/ (tính từ): cụ thể, rõ ràng. "Make something concrete" = làm cho điều gì cụ thể; danh từ concrete còn nghĩa là bê tông.
items.explanationEn: concrete /ˈkɒŋ.kriːt/ (adjective): specific and real, not abstract. "Make something concrete" means make it specific; as a noun concrete is also a building material.

items.question: Trong câu "Understanding the constraints that bound the solution", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding the constraints that bound the solution", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. "Time and budget constraints" = ràng buộc về thời gian và ngân sách.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limit or restriction. "Time and budget constraints" is a very common workplace phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Understanding the constraints that bound the solution", từ "bound" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding the constraints that bound the solution", what does "bound" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bound /baʊnd/ (động từ): giới hạn, bao quanh. "Bound" (động từ) = tạo ranh giới; danh từ boundary = ranh giới. Nghĩa khác: nhảy vọt.
items.explanationEn: bound /baʊnd/ (verb): to set the limits of. "Bound" as a verb means to form the limits; the noun is boundary. Another sense is to leap.

items.question: Trong câu "Not producing or refining more than is needed to learn and satisfy the need", từ "refine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not producing or refining more than is needed to learn and satisfy the need", what does "refine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: refine /rɪˈfaɪn/ (động từ): tinh chỉnh, làm rõ thêm. "Backlog refinement" = tinh chỉnh backlog; nghĩa gốc là tinh luyện (dầu, đường).
items.explanationEn: refine /rɪˈfaɪn/ (verb): to improve by adding detail. "Backlog refinement" is the agile use; the original sense is purifying oil or sugar.

items.question: Trong câu "Not producing or refining more than is needed to learn and satisfy the need", từ "satisfy" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not producing or refining more than is needed to learn and satisfy the need", what does "satisfy" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: satisfy /ˈsæt.ɪs.faɪ/ (động từ): đáp ứng, thỏa mãn. "Satisfy a need / requirement" = đáp ứng nhu cầu / yêu cầu.
items.explanationEn: satisfy /ˈsæt.ɪs.faɪ/ (verb): to meet or fulfil. "Satisfy a need / a requirement" are standard collocations.

items.question: Trong câu "The seven are not an ordered process.", từ "ordered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The seven are not an ordered process.", what does "ordered" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ordered /ˈɔːr.dərd/ (tính từ): có thứ tự. "An ordered list" = danh sách có thứ tự; order còn nghĩa là đặt hàng hoặc ra lệnh.
items.explanationEn: ordered /ˈɔːr.dərd/ (adjective): arranged in a sequence. "An ordered list" follows a sequence; order can also mean to buy or to command.

items.question: Trong câu "They are seven lenses an agile BA holds at once; the question is always which lens is governing the specific action.", từ "lens" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are seven lenses an agile BA holds at once; the question is always which lens is governing the specific action.", what does "lens" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a way of looking at something
a curved glass in a camera
items.explanation: lens /lenz/ (danh từ): lăng kính, góc nhìn. "Through the lens of" = qua lăng kính của; nghĩa đen là thấu kính.
items.explanationEn: lens /lenz/ (noun): a way of looking at something. "Through the lens of" means from a particular viewpoint; literally a lens is curved glass.

items.question: Trong câu "They are seven lenses an agile BA holds at once; the question is always which lens is governing the specific action.", từ "at once" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are seven lenses an agile BA holds at once; the question is always which lens is governing the specific action.", what does "at once" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at once /æt wʌns/ (cụm từ): cùng một lúc. "At once" có hai nghĩa: cùng lúc (như ở đây) và ngay lập tức.
items.explanationEn: at once /æt wʌns/ (phrase): at the same time. "At once" has two senses: simultaneously (as here) and immediately.

items.question: Trong câu "They are seven lenses an agile BA holds at once; the question is always which lens is governing the specific action.", từ "govern" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are seven lenses an agile BA holds at once; the question is always which lens is governing the specific action.", what does "govern" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: govern /ˈɡʌv.ərn/ (động từ): chi phối, quyết định. "Govern" = chi phối (quy tắc, yếu tố); nghĩa khác là cai trị một quốc gia.
items.explanationEn: govern /ˈɡʌv.ərn/ (verb): to control or determine. "Govern" means to control or determine; it also means to rule a country.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the single most worthwhile table in the topic.", từ "worthwhile" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the single most worthwhile table in the topic.", what does "worthwhile" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worthwhile /ˌwɜːrθˈwaɪl/ (tính từ): đáng giá, bõ công. "A worthwhile investment" = khoản đầu tư đáng giá.
items.explanationEn: worthwhile /ˌwɜːrθˈwaɪl/ (adjective): worth the time or effort. "A worthwhile investment" is a typical collocation.

items.question: Trong câu "empathy, customer viewpoint, decomposing customer needs, who the user is", từ "empathy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "empathy, customer viewpoint, decomposing customer needs, who the user is", what does "empathy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: empathy /ˈem.pə.θi/ (danh từ): sự đồng cảm. "Empathy for users" = đồng cảm với người dùng, nền tảng của design thinking.
items.explanationEn: empathy /ˈem.pə.θi/ (noun): understanding others' feelings. "Empathy for users" is the basis of design thinking.

items.question: Trong câu "prioritise, maximise value, continuously assess the work", từ "assess" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "prioritise, maximise value, continuously assess the work", what does "assess" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assess /əˈses/ (động từ): đánh giá. "Assess the risk / impact" = đánh giá rủi ro / tác động; danh từ là assessment.
items.explanationEn: assess /əˈses/ (verb): to evaluate. "Assess the risk / the impact" are common; the noun is assessment.

items.question: Trong câu "examples, scenarios, alternate and exception paths", từ "alternate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "examples, scenarios, alternate and exception paths", what does "alternate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: alternate /ˈɔːl.tər.nət/ (tính từ): thay thế, khác. "Alternate path" = luồng thay thế trong use case; nghĩa khác là xen kẽ (on alternate days).
items.explanationEn: alternate /ˈɔːl.tər.nət/ (adjective): offering another option. "Alternate path" is another flow in a use case; it can also mean every other (alternate days).

items.question: Trong câu "constraints, feasibility, what can actually be done", từ "feasibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "constraints, feasibility, what can actually be done", what does "feasibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: feasibility /ˌfiː.zəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính khả thi. "Feasibility study" = nghiên cứu khả thi; tính từ là feasible.
items.explanationEn: feasibility /ˌfiː.zəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): how possible something is. "Feasibility study" is a standard term; the adjective is feasible.

items.question: Trong câu "smallest version, only what is needed, only document what is needed, outdated information", từ "outdated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "smallest version, only what is needed, only document what is needed, outdated information", what does "outdated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: outdated /ˌaʊtˈdeɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): lỗi thời, cũ. "Outdated information" = thông tin lỗi thời; đồng nghĩa: out of date.
items.explanationEn: outdated /ˌaʊtˈdeɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): no longer current. "Outdated information" means it is no longer current; synonym: out of date.

items.question: Trong câu "The strongest trigger in the table is "constraints".", từ "trigger" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The strongest trigger in the table is "constraints".", what does "trigger" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the lever that fires a gun
something that sets off a reaction
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ər/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu kích hoạt. "Trigger word" = từ khóa gợi nhận diện; nghĩa đen là cò súng.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ər/ (noun): something that sets off a reaction. "Trigger word" is a cue word; literally a trigger is the lever that fires a gun.

items.question: Trong câu "big picture, outcome, market, enterprise-wide impact", từ "big picture" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "big picture, outcome, market, enterprise-wide impact", what does "big picture" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: big picture /bɪɡ ˈpɪk.tʃər/ (cụm từ): bức tranh tổng thể. "See the big picture" = nhìn bức tranh tổng thể, trái với "get lost in the details".
items.explanationEn: big picture /bɪɡ ˈpɪk.tʃər/ (phrase): the overall view. "See the big picture" is the opposite of getting lost in the details.

items.question: Trong câu "big picture, outcome, market, enterprise-wide impact", từ "impact" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "big picture, outcome, market, enterprise-wide impact", what does "impact" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (danh từ): tác động, ảnh hưởng. "Have an impact on" = có tác động đến; nghĩa đen là cú va chạm.
items.explanationEn: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (noun): an effect or influence. "Have an impact on" means to affect; literally impact is a collision.

items.question: Trong câu "The pairs below get swapped most often, and each has a tidy boundary.", từ "swap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The pairs below get swapped most often, and each has a tidy boundary.", what does "swap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: swap /swɒp/ (động từ): tráo đổi cho nhau. "Swap A for B" = đổi A lấy B; "get swapped" = bị tráo/nhầm cho nhau.
items.explanationEn: swap /swɒp/ (verb): to exchange one for another. "Swap A for B" means exchange; "get swapped" means be mixed up with each other.

items.question: Trong câu "The pairs below get swapped most often, and each has a tidy boundary.", từ "tidy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The pairs below get swapped most often, and each has a tidy boundary.", what does "tidy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tidy /ˈtaɪ.di/ (tính từ): gọn gàng, rõ ràng. "A tidy boundary" = ranh giới rõ ràng; "a tidy sum" lại là một khoản tiền kha khá.
items.explanationEn: tidy /ˈtaɪ.di/ (adjective): neat and clear. "A tidy boundary" is clean and clear; "a tidy sum" means a fairly large amount of money.

items.question: Trong câu "The pairs below get swapped most often, and each has a tidy boundary.", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The pairs below get swapped most often, and each has a tidy boundary.", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "Set boundaries" = đặt ranh giới; "system boundary" = ranh giới hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (noun): a dividing line. "Set boundaries" and "system boundary" are frequent phrases.

items.question: Trong câu "Avoid waste is about not producing more than needed (smallest slice, minimal documentation).", từ "slice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Avoid waste is about not producing more than needed (smallest slice, minimal documentation).", what does "slice" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a thin piece of the work
items.explanation: slice /slaɪs/ (danh từ): lát cắt nhỏ (công việc). "Vertical slice" = lát cắt dọc một tính năng hoàn chỉnh nhỏ; nghĩa đen là lát (bánh, thịt).
items.explanationEn: slice /slaɪs/ (noun): a thin piece of the work. "Vertical slice" is a thin end-to-end piece of a feature; literally a slice of bread or meat.

items.question: Trong câu "Avoid waste is about not producing more than needed (smallest slice, minimal documentation).", từ "minimal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Avoid waste is about not producing more than needed (smallest slice, minimal documentation).", what does "minimal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: minimal /ˈmɪn.ɪ.məl/ (tính từ): tối thiểu. "Minimal documentation" = tài liệu tối thiểu; so sánh minimum (danh từ).
items.explanationEn: minimal /ˈmɪn.ɪ.məl/ (adjective): the least possible. "Minimal documentation" means as little as needed; compare the noun minimum.

items.question: Trong câu "Analyzing value is about the ordering of work.", từ "ordering" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analyzing value is about the ordering of work.", what does "ordering" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ordering /ˈɔːr.dər.ɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc sắp thứ tự. "The ordering of work" = thứ tự ưu tiên công việc; "ordering online" lại là đặt hàng.
items.explanationEn: ordering /ˈɔːr.dər.ɪŋ/ (noun): arranging in sequence. "The ordering of work" means its sequence; "ordering online" means buying.

items.question: Trong câu "Understanding who the customer is and decomposing their viewpoint = think as a customer.", từ "decompose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding who the customer is and decomposing their viewpoint = think as a customer.", what does "decompose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decompose /ˌdiː.kəmˈpoʊz/ (động từ): phân rã, chia nhỏ. "Decompose a problem" = chia nhỏ vấn đề; trong sinh học nghĩa là phân hủy.
items.explanationEn: decompose /ˌdiː.kəmˈpoʊz/ (verb): to split into parts. "Decompose a problem" means break it down; in biology it means to rot.

items.question: Trong câu "Understanding who the customer is and decomposing their viewpoint = think as a customer.", từ "viewpoint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding who the customer is and decomposing their viewpoint = think as a customer.", what does "viewpoint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: viewpoint /ˈvjuː.pɔɪnt/ (danh từ): quan điểm. "From a user's viewpoint" = theo quan điểm người dùng; nghĩa đen là điểm ngắm cảnh.
items.explanationEn: viewpoint /ˈvjuː.pɔɪnt/ (noun): a way of thinking. "From a user's viewpoint" means from their perspective; literally a place to view scenery.

items.question: Trong câu "If the team happens to be collaborating but the point of the sentence is context or outcome alignment → See the whole.", từ "happen to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the team happens to be collaborating but the point of the sentence is context or outcome alignment → See the whole.", what does "happen to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: happen to /ˈhæp.ən tuː/ (cụm từ): tình cờ (làm gì). "Happen to do" = tình cờ làm gì; ví dụ "Do you happen to know...?" = bạn có tình cờ biết...?
items.explanationEn: happen to /ˈhæp.ən tuː/ (phrase): to do something by chance. "Happen to do" means by chance, as in the polite question "Do you happen to know...?"

items.question: Trong câu "If the team happens to be collaborating but the point of the sentence is context or outcome alignment → See the whole.", từ "alignment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the team happens to be collaborating but the point of the sentence is context or outcome alignment → See the whole.", what does "alignment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alignment /əˈlaɪn.mənt/ (danh từ): sự thống nhất, đồng bộ. "Get alignment with stakeholders" = đạt thống nhất với các bên liên quan; nghĩa khác là căn lề.
items.explanationEn: alignment /əˈlaɪn.mənt/ (noun): agreement toward a shared aim. "Get alignment with stakeholders" means reach agreement; it also means text positioning.

items.question: Trong câu ""Only documenting what is needed at the time" is Avoid waste", từ "at the time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Only documenting what is needed at the time" is Avoid waste", what does "at the time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at the time /æt ðə taɪm/ (cụm từ): vào lúc đó. "At the time" = vào thời điểm đó; khác "on time" = đúng giờ.
items.explanationEn: at the time /æt ðə taɪm/ (phrase): at that moment. "At the time" means at that moment; do not confuse with "on time" (punctually).

items.question: Trong câu "The general rule: nearly every agile scenario contains collaboration.", từ "nearly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The general rule: nearly every agile scenario contains collaboration.", what does "nearly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: nearly /ˈnɪr.li/ (trạng từ): gần như. "Nearly every / nearly all" = gần như mọi; đồng nghĩa almost.
items.explanationEn: nearly /ˈnɪr.li/ (adverb): almost. "Nearly every / nearly all" is a synonym of almost.

items.question: Trong câu "So "the team is collaborating" is almost never sufficient reason to pick the collaboration principle.", từ "sufficient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So "the team is collaborating" is almost never sufficient reason to pick the collaboration principle.", what does "sufficient" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sufficient /səˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (tính từ): đủ. "Sufficient reason / evidence" = đủ lý do / bằng chứng; trái nghĩa insufficient.
items.explanationEn: sufficient /səˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (adjective): enough. "Sufficient reason / evidence" is common; the opposite is insufficient.

items.question: Trong câu "A distinct question type asks: how is principle X applied at horizon Y?", từ "distinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A distinct question type asks: how is principle X applied at horizon Y?", what does "distinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (tính từ): riêng biệt, khác hẳn. "Distinct from" = khác biệt với; nghĩa khác là rõ nét (a distinct smell).
items.explanationEn: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (adjective): separate and different. "Distinct from" means different from; it can also mean clearly noticeable (a distinct smell).

items.question: Trong câu "A distinct question type asks: how is principle X applied at horizon Y?", từ "horizon" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A distinct question type asks: how is principle X applied at horizon Y?", what does "horizon" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: horizon /həˈraɪ.zən/ (danh từ): tầm hoạch định. "Planning horizon" = tầm hoạch định; nghĩa đen là đường chân trời.
items.explanationEn: horizon /həˈraɪ.zən/ (noun): a planning time span. "Planning horizon" is how far ahead you plan; literally the line where earth meets sky.

items.question: Trong câu "The same principle scales with the horizon.", từ "scale" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same principle scales with the horizon.", what does "scale" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to change in size along with
items.explanation: scale /skeɪl/ (động từ): thay đổi quy mô theo. "Scale with" = tăng/giảm quy mô theo; "scale up" = mở rộng. Nghĩa khác: leo lên.
items.explanationEn: scale /skeɪl/ (verb): to change in size along with. "Scale with" means grow in proportion; "scale up" means expand. It can also mean to climb.

items.question: Trong câu "Considering the market, political climate, and current organisational capabilities, strengths and challenges", từ "climate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Considering the market, political climate, and current organisational capabilities, strengths and challenges", what does "climate" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the general mood of a situation
items.explanation: climate /ˈklaɪ.mət/ (danh từ): tình hình chung. "Political / economic climate" = tình hình chính trị / kinh tế; nghĩa đen là khí hậu.
items.explanationEn: climate /ˈklaɪ.mət/ (noun): the general mood of a situation. "Political / economic climate" means the general situation; literally climate is weather.

items.question: Trong câu "Considering the market, political climate, and current organisational capabilities, strengths and challenges", từ "capability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Considering the market, political climate, and current organisational capabilities, strengths and challenges", what does "capability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): năng lực. "Organisational capabilities" = năng lực tổ chức; tính từ là capable.
items.explanationEn: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): ability to do things. "Organisational capabilities" are what a company is able to do; the adjective is capable.

items.question: Trong câu "Making sure each user story has acceptance criteria and connects to the outcome", từ "criteria" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Making sure each user story has acceptance criteria and connects to the outcome", what does "criteria" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criteria /kraɪˈtɪr.i.ə/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. "Acceptance criteria" = tiêu chí chấp nhận; số ít là criterion.
items.explanationEn: criteria /kraɪˈtɪr.i.ə/ (noun): standards used for judging. "Acceptance criteria" is a key agile term; the singular is criterion.

items.question: Trong câu "Making sure decisions are based on current information and that the work is still relevant to organisational goals", từ "relevant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Making sure decisions are based on current information and that the work is still relevant to organisational goals", what does "relevant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: relevant /ˈrel.ə.vənt/ (tính từ): liên quan, phù hợp. "Relevant to" = liên quan / phù hợp với; trái nghĩa irrelevant.
items.explanationEn: relevant /ˈrel.ə.vənt/ (adjective): connected, applicable. "Relevant to" means connected and appropriate; the opposite is irrelevant.

items.question: Trong câu "Making sure teams prioritise in backlog refinement", từ "refinement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Making sure teams prioritise in backlog refinement", what does "refinement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: refinement /rɪˈfaɪn.mənt/ (danh từ): sự tinh chỉnh, làm rõ. "Backlog refinement" = buổi tinh chỉnh backlog; nghĩa khác là sự tinh tế, lịch lãm.
items.explanationEn: refinement /rɪˈfaɪn.mənt/ (noun): improving by adding detail. "Backlog refinement" is an agile event; refinement can also mean elegance.

items.question: Trong câu "Collaborating with the team and with other teams on related initiatives", từ "initiative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Collaborating with the team and with other teams on related initiatives", what does "initiative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: initiative /ɪˈnɪʃ.ə.tɪv/ (danh từ): sáng kiến, dự án lớn. "Strategic initiative" = sáng kiến chiến lược; "take the initiative" = chủ động.
items.explanationEn: initiative /ɪˈnɪʃ.ə.tɪv/ (noun): a planned programme of work. "Strategic initiative" is a programme; "take the initiative" means act first.

items.question: Trong câu "This is a rich source of traps.", từ "rich" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is a rich source of traps.", what does "rich" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: rich /rɪtʃ/ (tính từ): dồi dào, phong phú. "A rich source of" = nguồn dồi dào của; nghĩa quen thuộc là giàu có.
items.explanationEn: rich /rɪtʃ/ (adjective): plentiful, full of something. "A rich source of" means plentiful; the everyday sense is wealthy.

items.question: Trong câu "This is a rich source of traps.", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is a rich source of traps.", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): cái bẫy, chỗ dễ sai. "Fall into a trap" = mắc bẫy; nghĩa đen là bẫy thú.
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): something designed to mislead. "Fall into a trap" means be misled; literally a device for catching animals.

items.question: Trong câu ""Collaborating with the team to refine user stories" sounds like initiative-horizon collaboration but is delivery-horizon work", từ "sound like" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Collaborating with the team to refine user stories" sounds like initiative-horizon collaboration but is delivery-horizon work", what does "sound like" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to seem to be, from description
items.explanation: sound like /saʊnd laɪk/ (cụm từ): nghe có vẻ là. "Sounds like a plan" = nghe hợp lý đấy; sound like = có vẻ là (dựa trên mô tả).
items.explanationEn: sound like /saʊnd laɪk/ (phrase): to seem to be, from description. "Sounds like a plan" is common in meetings; sound like means seem to be.

items.question: Trong câu "The Business Analysis Core Concept Model (BACCM) is the conceptual backbone of the whole BABOK.", từ "conceptual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Business Analysis Core Concept Model (BACCM) is the conceptual backbone of the whole BABOK.", what does "conceptual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: conceptual /kənˈsep.tʃu.əl/ (tính từ): thuộc khái niệm. "Conceptual model" = mô hình khái niệm.
items.explanationEn: conceptual /kənˈsep.tʃu.əl/ (adjective): relating to ideas. "Conceptual model" is a model of ideas rather than details.

items.question: Trong câu "The Business Analysis Core Concept Model (BACCM) is the conceptual backbone of the whole BABOK.", từ "backbone" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Business Analysis Core Concept Model (BACCM) is the conceptual backbone of the whole BABOK.", what does "backbone" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: backbone /ˈbæk.boʊn/ (danh từ): xương sống, nền tảng chính. "The backbone of" = trụ cột, nền tảng; nghĩa đen là cột sống. Còn có nghĩa: bản lĩnh.
items.explanationEn: backbone /ˈbæk.boʊn/ (noun): the main supporting part. "The backbone of" is the main support; literally the spine. It can also mean courage.

items.question: Trong câu "There are exactly six concepts, no more and no fewer.", từ "no more and no fewer" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There are exactly six concepts, no more and no fewer.", what does "no more and no fewer" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: no more and no fewer /noʊ mɔːr ænd noʊ ˈfjuː.ər/ (cụm từ): không hơn không kém. "No more and no fewer" = không hơn không kém (dùng fewer cho danh từ đếm được).
items.explanationEn: no more and no fewer /noʊ mɔːr ænd noʊ ˈfjuː.ər/ (phrase): exactly that number. "No more and no fewer" means exactly; fewer is used with countable nouns.

items.question: Trong câu "The act of transformation in response to a need", từ "transformation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The act of transformation in response to a need", what does "transformation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: transformation /ˌtræns.fərˈmeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự chuyển đổi. "Digital transformation" = chuyển đổi số.
items.explanationEn: transformation /ˌtræns.fərˈmeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a major change in form. "Digital transformation" is a very common business term.

items.question: Trong câu "The act of transformation in response to a need", từ "in response to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The act of transformation in response to a need", what does "in response to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in response to /ɪn rɪˈspɒns tuː/ (cụm từ): để đáp lại. "In response to feedback" = để đáp lại phản hồi.
items.explanationEn: in response to /ɪn rɪˈspɒns tuː/ (phrase): as a reaction to. "In response to feedback" is a common workplace phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "A problem or opportunity to be addressed", từ "address" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A problem or opportunity to be addressed", what does "address" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: address /əˈdres/ (động từ): giải quyết, xử lý. "Address an issue" = giải quyết vấn đề; nghĩa khác là phát biểu trước ai (address the audience).
items.explanationEn: address /əˈdres/ (verb): to deal with. "Address an issue" means deal with it; it also means to speak to an audience.

items.question: Trong câu "A group or individual with a relationship to the change, the need or the solution", từ "individual" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A group or individual with a relationship to the change, the need or the solution", what does "individual" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: individual /ˌɪn.dɪˈvɪdʒ.u.əl/ (danh từ): cá nhân. "Groups and individuals" = nhóm và cá nhân; cũng dùng làm tính từ (individual needs).
items.explanationEn: individual /ˌɪn.dɪˈvɪdʒ.u.əl/ (noun): a single person. "Groups and individuals" is a common pair; it is also an adjective (individual needs).

items.question: Trong câu "The worth, importance or usefulness of something to a stakeholder within a context", từ "worth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The worth, importance or usefulness of something to a stakeholder within a context", what does "worth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: worth /wɜːrθ/ (danh từ): giá trị. "Prove your worth" = chứng tỏ giá trị bản thân; "net worth" = giá trị tài sản ròng.
items.explanationEn: worth /wɜːrθ/ (noun): value or merit. "Prove your worth" and "net worth" are common uses of the noun.

items.question: Trong câu "The circumstances that influence, are influenced by, and provide understanding of the change", từ "circumstance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The circumstances that influence, are influenced by, and provide understanding of the change", what does "circumstance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: circumstance /ˈsɜːr.kəm.stæns/ (danh từ): hoàn cảnh. "Under the circumstances" = trong hoàn cảnh này; "in no circumstances" = dù thế nào cũng không.
items.explanationEn: circumstance /ˈsɜːr.kəm.stæns/ (noun): a condition or situation. "Under the circumstances" and "in no circumstances" are fixed phrases.

items.question: Trong câu "The circumstances that influence, are influenced by, and provide understanding of the change", từ "influence" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The circumstances that influence, are influenced by, and provide understanding of the change", what does "influence" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: influence /ˈɪn.flu.əns/ (động từ): ảnh hưởng, tác động. "Influence a decision" = ảnh hưởng đến quyết định; không dùng "influence on" với động từ.
items.explanationEn: influence /ˈɪn.flu.əns/ (verb): to have an effect on. "Influence a decision" takes a direct object; the noun takes on (an influence on).

items.question: Trong câu "The wrong answers to "which are the six core concepts" always mix in plausible agile vocabulary", từ "mix in" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The wrong answers to "which are the six core concepts" always mix in plausible agile vocabulary", what does "mix in" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: mix in /mɪks ɪn/ (cụm từ): trộn lẫn vào. "Mix in" = trộn thêm vào; "mix up" = nhầm lẫn.
items.explanationEn: mix in /mɪks ɪn/ (phrase): to add into a set. "Mix in" means add into; compare "mix up" (confuse).

items.question: Trong câu "The wrong answers to "which are the six core concepts" always mix in plausible agile vocabulary", từ "plausible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The wrong answers to "which are the six core concepts" always mix in plausible agile vocabulary", what does "plausible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plausible /ˈplɔː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): nghe có vẻ hợp lý. "A plausible explanation" = lời giải thích nghe hợp lý (nhưng chưa chắc đúng).
items.explanationEn: plausible /ˈplɔː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): seeming reasonable. "A plausible explanation" seems reasonable but may not be true.

items.question: Trong câu "A fast trick: some distractor lists contain only five items", từ "trick" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A fast trick: some distractor lists contain only five items", what does "trick" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trick /trɪk/ (danh từ): mẹo. "A useful trick" = một mẹo hữu ích; nghĩa khác là trò lừa (play a trick on).
items.explanationEn: trick /trɪk/ (noun): a clever method. "A useful trick" is a handy method; "play a trick on someone" means deceive them.

items.question: Trong câu "A fast trick: some distractor lists contain only five items", từ "distractor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A fast trick: some distractor lists contain only five items", what does "distractor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: distractor /dɪˈstræk.tər/ (danh từ): phương án gây nhiễu. "Distractor" = phương án sai gây nhiễu trong câu trắc nghiệm; động từ distract = làm xao nhãng.
items.explanationEn: distractor /dɪˈstræk.tər/ (noun): a wrong answer option. "Distractor" is a wrong option in a multiple-choice item; the verb distract means to divert attention.

items.question: Trong câu "counting eliminates them outright", từ "eliminate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "counting eliminates them outright", what does "eliminate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: eliminate /ɪˈlɪm.ɪ.neɪt/ (động từ): loại bỏ. "Eliminate options" = loại trừ phương án; "process of elimination" = phương pháp loại trừ.
items.explanationEn: eliminate /ɪˈlɪm.ɪ.neɪt/ (verb): to rule out. "Eliminate options" and "process of elimination" are useful exam phrases.

items.question: Trong câu "counting eliminates them outright", từ "outright" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "counting eliminates them outright", what does "outright" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: outright /ˌaʊtˈraɪt/ (trạng từ): dứt khoát, ngay. "Reject outright" = bác bỏ thẳng thừng; "win outright" = thắng tuyệt đối.
items.explanationEn: outright /ˌaʊtˈraɪt/ (adverb): at once, completely. "Reject outright" means reject completely; "win outright" means win clearly.

items.question: Trong câu "Seeing the whole is entirely about context", từ "entirely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Seeing the whole is entirely about context", what does "entirely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: entirely /ɪnˈtaɪər.li/ (trạng từ): hoàn toàn. "Entirely different / entirely about" = hoàn toàn khác / hoàn toàn về.
items.explanationEn: entirely /ɪnˈtaɪər.li/ (adverb): completely. "Entirely different" and "entirely about" are common collocations.

items.question: Trong câu "Getting real using examples is all about understanding the need", từ "all about" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Getting real using examples is all about understanding the need", what does "all about" (phrase) mean?
options: cốt lõi là, chủ yếu là
items.explanation: all about /ɔːl əˈbaʊt/ (cụm từ): cốt lõi là, chủ yếu là. "It's all about..." = cốt lõi là...; ví dụ "Agile is all about feedback."
items.explanationEn: all about /ɔːl əˈbaʊt/ (phrase): mainly focused on. "It's all about..." states the core point, e.g. "Agile is all about feedback."

items.question: Trong câu "Value is the concept those two principles embody", từ "embody" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Value is the concept those two principles embody", what does "embody" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: embody /ɪmˈbɒd.i/ (động từ): thể hiện rõ. "Embody values" = thể hiện các giá trị; danh từ embodiment = hiện thân.
items.explanationEn: embody /ɪmˈbɒd.i/ (verb): to express or represent. "Embody values" means represent them; the noun is embodiment.

items.question: Trong câu "Change cuts across every principle, so it is never the answer to a single-principle question", từ "cut across" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Change cuts across every principle, so it is never the answer to a single-principle question", what does "cut across" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: cut across /kʌt əˈkrɒs/ (cụm từ): xuyên suốt (mọi phần). "Cut across departments" = xuyên suốt các phòng ban; nghĩa đen là đi tắt qua.
items.explanationEn: cut across /kʌt əˈkrɒs/ (phrase): to affect all parts of. "Cut across departments" means affect all of them; literally to take a shortcut through.

items.question: Trong câu "when a question asks you to map a BACCM concept onto one principle", từ "map" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "when a question asks you to map a BACCM concept onto one principle", what does "map" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: map /mæp/ (động từ): ánh xạ tương ứng. "Map A onto / to B" = ánh xạ A sang B; "map out" = lên kế hoạch chi tiết.
items.explanationEn: map /mæp/ (verb): to link to a match. "Map A onto B" means match A to B; "map out" means plan in detail.

items.question: Trong câu "Change is almost certainly not the answer.", từ "almost certainly" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Change is almost certainly not the answer.", what does "almost certainly" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: almost certainly /ˈɔːl.moʊst ˈsɜːr.tən.li/ (cụm từ): gần như chắc chắn. "Almost certainly" = gần như chắc chắn; mạnh hơn probably.
items.explanationEn: almost certainly /ˈɔːl.moʊst ˈsɜːr.tən.li/ (phrase): very nearly sure. "Almost certainly" is stronger than probably.

items.question: Trong câu "Learn the trigger words, not the definitions", từ "definition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Learn the trigger words, not the definitions", what does "definition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: definition /ˌdef.ɪˈnɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): định nghĩa. "By definition" = theo định nghĩa; "high definition" = độ nét cao.
items.explanationEn: definition /ˌdef.ɪˈnɪʃ.ən/ (noun): the meaning of a term. "By definition" is a set phrase; "high definition" refers to image sharpness.

items.question: Trong câu "The same principle looks different at each horizon", từ "horizon" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same principle looks different at each horizon", what does "horizon" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: horizon /həˈraɪ.zən/ (danh từ): tầm (hoạch định). "Short-term horizon" = tầm ngắn hạn; nghĩa đen là đường chân trời.
items.explanationEn: horizon /həˈraɪ.zən/ (noun): a planning time span. "Short-term horizon" is a near planning span; literally horizon is where earth meets sky.

items.question: Trong câu "Count the items to eliminate distractors fast.", từ "eliminate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Count the items to eliminate distractors fast.", what does "eliminate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: eliminate /ɪˈlɪm.ɪ.neɪt/ (động từ): loại bỏ. "Eliminate waste" = loại bỏ lãng phí, cụm rất hay gặp trong Lean.
items.explanationEn: eliminate /ɪˈlɪm.ɪ.neɪt/ (verb): to rule out. "Eliminate waste" is a key Lean phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Change maps to every principle", từ "map to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Change maps to every principle", what does "map to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: map to /mæp tuː/ (cụm từ): tương ứng với. "X maps to Y" = X tương ứng với Y, rất hay dùng khi đối chiếu yêu cầu.
items.explanationEn: map to /mæp tuː/ (phrase): to correspond to. "X maps to Y" is used when tracing one item to another.

items.question: Trong câu "nearly every scenario has it.", từ "scenario" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "nearly every scenario has it.", what does "scenario" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scenario /səˈnær.i.oʊ/ (danh từ): tình huống (mô tả). "Best-case / worst-case scenario" = tình huống tốt nhất / xấu nhất.
items.explanationEn: scenario /səˈnær.i.oʊ/ (noun): a described situation. "Best-case / worst-case scenario" are common planning phrases.
